summary: Accepted the beneficiary relationship from structural copper scarcity to Southern Copper with high positive sensitivity and medium confidence. Current issuer evidence shows direct transmission through copper revenue, margins, cash flow, reserves, and funded growth, while lower production, grades, recoveries, by-product credits, project spending, jurisdictional risk, and adverse current valuation limit per-share transmission. Updated the relationship page, catalog, log, and canonical relationship row; no strategy or follow-up operation was created.

evidence.claim: Southern Copper reported Q1 2026 sales of USD 4.25 billion, net income of USD 1.58 billion, diluted income per share of USD 1.92, operating cash flow of USD 1.69 billion, capital investment of USD 441.9 million, and copper production down 4.0% year over year. The results demonstrate direct copper-economics transmission while preserving volume, cost, and capital-intensity counterweights.

The maintained security review records Southern Copper's integrated Peru and Mexico operations, 51.1 million tonnes of claimed contained-copper reserves, negative USD 0.11/lb Q1 cash cost after by-product credits, lower production, a project program exceeding USD 20.5 billion, and bounded downside and base scenarios 40.0% and 22.9% below the USD 179.32 market mark.

The maintained idea defines the causal channel from constrained mine supply and copper demand to low-cost producer cash flow while preserving supply response, recycling, substitution, operating execution, jurisdiction, capital intensity, and valuation as contrary evidence.
